notes.title: Folk Tales: Alageyik Demo – New Features and Improvements
notes.content:
Added Mechanics:

[list]
[*] Jumpscare system added.
[*] Camera bugs fixed, camera shake effect implemented.
[*] Main menu with "Any Key" button added.
[*] New details and environmental elements added to level design.
[*] Character’s kick mechanic replaced with knife usage.
[*] Enemy attack animations and variety enhanced.
[/list]

notes.title: Folk Tales: Ala Geyik Demo – New Features and Improvements
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Skull and ghost attacks have been added to enemy attacks.
[*] Automatic magazine reloading has been added.
[*] The main character's damage details have been improved (added damage sound and blood effects).
[/list]

notes.title: Folk Tales: Ala Geyik Demo – Bug Fix Update
notes.content: We fixed a bug where the character was stuck and couldn't move!
